_comment: 26.3: vanilla split ItemInHandRenderer into the state class FirstPersonHandsAndItems (holds mainHandItem, drives tick) and the renderer FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRenderer (submitHandsWithItems/submitArmWithItem), so the old ItemInHandRendererMixin is split accordingly: FirstPersonHandsAndItemsMixin carries KeepingItemRenderer, FirstPersonHandsAndItemsRendererMixin owns the submitArmWithItem call site for TACZ viewmodels so generic first-person hand transforms yield without affecting ordinary items. PlayerModelMixin applies TACZ/PAL third-person poses from AvatarRenderState.
